## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D zombie survival game in the existing project.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport at most 1280px wide) for visual checks, and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Created a self-contained browser game called “LAST LIGHT” in `index.html`, with canvas-rendered survival gameplay and responsive touch controls.

## Work State

### Completed
- Added game UI, title/game-over overlays, health/ammo/night/kills HUD, and responsive mobile control elements in `index.html`.
- Implemented player movement, aiming, shooting, reloading, zombies and brute variants, escalating waves, pickups, obstacles, particles, and survival scoring.

### Active
- Validate JavaScript and gameplay in a browser; fix any issues found.
- Capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- The game source has not yet been syntax-checked or browser-tested.

## Next Move
1. Extract the inline script from `index.html` and run `node --check`.
2. Run the project and open it with `playwright-cli`; test starting, movement, shooting, waves, and game over.
3. Save and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot; fix any runtime or visual issues.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Contains the complete game implementation; currently modified and uncommitted.

## Important Context
- An earlier attempt to extract the script failed because the file was initially incomplete; the game code was subsequently added in multiple edits. Ensure the final script and HTML are complete before testing.
